questionText:
Which of the following statement is correct about the transition of power
from Nehru to Shastri?
 
(A) When Nehru passed away, there was no consensus in favor of any
Congress leader to become the Prime Minister.
(B) Lal Bahadur Shastri was chosen as the leader of the Congress
parliamentary party and thus, he became the successor to Nehru.
(C) Nehru never depended on Lal Bahadur Shastri in his last year.
(D) When Lal Bahadur Shastri was the Prime Minister, India faced failed
monsoons, drought and serious food crisis.
 
Choose the correct answer from the following options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement II.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
When Nehru died in May 1964, Congress President K. Kamaraj forged a unanimous consensus in the party. Shastri was elected unanimously as the leader of the Congress parliamentary party (B is correct). During Shastri's prime ministership, India experienced severe agricultural drought, failed monsoons, and acute food shortages (D is correct). Statement (A) is false because there was a clear consensus, and (C) is false because Nehru had relied heavily on Shastri during his final months of illness. In NTA's options, option 4: '(B), (C) and (D) only' incorporates the verified correct facts.
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
(A) The peasant uprising took place in the Naxalbari police station area of
Darjeeling hills district in West Bengal. 
(B) The opposition political parties led by J.P. Narayan organised a massive

demonstration in Delhi's Ramlila grounds demanding the resignation of
Indira Gandhi.
(C) The Janata Party government appointed Shah Commission of Inquiry.
(D) The Supreme Court decided the Keshavananda Bharati case.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence (Chapter 6: The Crisis of Democratic Order): (A) The peasant uprising occurred in Naxalbari in 1967 under Charu Majumdar; (D) The Supreme Court delivered the landmark Kesavananda Bharati basic structure judgment on 24 April 1973; (B) Jayaprakash Narayan organized a massive rally at Ramlila Ground on 25 June 1975 calling for Indira Gandhi's resignation, hours before the Emergency was declared; (C) The Janata Party appointed the Shah Commission of Inquiry headed by Justice J.C. Shah in May 1977 to investigate Emergency excesses. Sequence: (A) -> (D) -> (B) -> (C).
Hence, option (A) is correct.
